extracted.intended_audience: Internet Archive users / catalog shoppers / librarians
extracted.subtask_description: Catalog page for a digitized zine showing item metadata, content warnings/flag categories, and download options. Not a style or peer-review rubric but contains moderation/flagging categories and bibliographic fields.

rubrics_metrics.name: Flag: Graphic Violence
rubrics_metrics.description: Flag this item for Graphic Violence

rubrics_metrics.name: Flag: Explicit Sexual Content
rubrics_metrics.description: Flag this item for Explicit Sexual Content

rubrics_metrics.name: Flag: Hate Speech
rubrics_metrics.description: Flag this item for Hate Speech

rubrics_metrics.name: Flag: Misleading/Inaccurate/Missing Metadata
rubrics_metrics.description: Flag this item for Misleading/Inaccurate/Missing Metadata

rubrics_metrics.name: Topical classification (Topics/Collection)
rubrics_metrics.description: Topics and collections used to classify the item (e.g., 'anarchism'; collections: 'misczinesanarchism', 'zines').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used for discoverability and grouping within the archive.

rubrics_metrics.name: Bibliographic metadata fields
rubrics_metrics.description: Standard item metadata fields shown on the page: language (Spanish), pages (16), item size (58.1M), place (Valladolid, Spain), added date, identifiers (identifier, identifier-ark), OCR engine, scanner, PPI.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These fields document the item and support cataloging, access, and remediation (e.g., providing DAISY/EPUB/PDF downloads).

rubrics_metrics.name: User reviews / community ratings
rubrics_metrics.description: Presence of user reviews (e.g., 'Reviews 121') and ability to 'Add Review'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Community feedback can serve as informal evaluation of the item but no formal scoring rubric is provided on the page.
